title: Myerson Interaction Index
summary: This paper introduces the Myerson interaction index (MII), an extension of the Shapley interaction index to cooperative games with communication structures restricted by graphs. We establish a formal framework for interaction indices on graphs and provide an axiomatic characterization of the MII based on component efficiency, fairness, and veto partnership consistency. Furthermore, we analyse network-induced interaction to distinguish between effects arising from the graph topology and those stemming from the game's intrinsic synergies.
